description: The plot illustrates how ACC (%) varies with co-occurrence number for an unedited model (“Base”) and five editing methods (FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, ROME). The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale with major tick labels at 10¹, 10², and 10³ (with the plotted points appearing at four discrete co-occurrence values spanning from the low tens to a few thousand). The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)”, uses a linear scale, and ranges from 60 to 85 with regularly spaced tick marks every 5 percentage points. The Base series is a black solid line with circular markers, rising from about 62.7 at the lowest co-occurrence point to about 68.7 at the highest, with intermediate values near 65.1 and 67.0. FT is a blue solid line with downward-pointing triangle markers, increasing from about 64.0 to about 70.6 (around 67.1 and 69.9 at the middle points). IKE is a red solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers, increasing from about 66.2 to about 72.4 (about 69.7 and 71.5 mid-way). MEND is a brown solid line with diamond markers, increasing from about 68.8 to about 77.0 (about 73.0 and 75.2 in between). MEMIT is a purple solid line with pentagon markers, increasing from about 68.0 to about 74.8 (about 72.0 and 73.4 at the middle points). ROME is a green solid line with square markers, increasing from about 73.2 to about 81.5 (about 77.5 and 79.2 at the middle points).
